newsitem.title: THAILAND: More Thai rice on way to Iraq under UN scheme.
newsitem.headline: More Thai rice on way to Iraq under UN scheme.

text.p: Thailand is scheduled to ship another 12,500 tonnes of 15 percent grade rice to Iraq later this month under the UN-approved oil-for-food plan, trade sources said on Thursday.

The shipment would be part of a $21-million rice deal Iraq reached with Thailand after the oil-for-food scheme went into effect in December to alleviate the impact of United Nations trade sanctions imposed on Iraq for its 1990 invasion of Kuwait.
Vessel Fixed Star, which arrived at a Thai port on March 17, was likely to leave for Iraq either by the end of this month or early April, they said.

On Wednesday, another vessel arrived at Iraq's Gulf port of Umm Qasr with 13,000 tonnes of Thai rice and became the first substantial cargo of food supplies under the oil-for-food deal which is worth $2 billion of oil exports in six months.
